messages:
Kai (Design): quick idea — add a compact p95 mini-spark that pins while scrubbing and a small "sampled" tag when sampling is active. also propose a granularity toggle (auto/1m/5m) to reduce surprise jumps. figma: https://figma.com/...
Noah (PM): nice. product Q: auto granularity should default to 'auto' for long ranges? when auto, show a small tooltip explaining downsampling.
Riley (Frontend): agree on auto. impl notes: pointer debounce 110ms, keyboard debounce 60ms. live preview smoothing 900ms to reduce bucket hopping. we can avoid refetch when only granularity changes by returning aggregated series for each granularity.
Sasha (SRE): telemetry: emit `viz.granularity_change` and `viz.sampling_flag`. also, keep an "Exact" menu action to fetch raw un-sampled data for debugging.
Iris (A11y): a11y nits:
- mini-spark must be focusable and announce "p95: 320ms, sampled" when sampled
- granularity toggle must be a segmented control with aria-pressed states and keyboard shortcuts
- toast/banner when sampling auto-applies should be aria-live polite: "Sampling active: results may be approximate"
Kai (Design): copy suggestions: label = "Sample rate"; tooltip = "Applied on long ranges to reduce query cost; values may be approximate." Granularity tooltip: "Auto chooses best bucket size for range."
Noah (PM): short copy approved. UI behavior: show ephemeral banner (6s) + persistent mini-tag on p95.
Riley (Frontend): i'll wire `meta.sampled` in the heatmap payload and implement debounce/smoothing values. will add keyboard nav per Iris' spec. PR soon.
Sasha (SRE): will add telemetry metrics and a dashboard for `viz.sampling_flag` occurrences. also document fallback flows for "Exact" fetches.
Iris (A11y): i'll validate NVDA + VoiceOver and confirm focus order: presets -> granularity -> scrubber -> p95 spark -> sampling control.
design-bot: opened PR #5302: "mini-spark + granularity toggle + sampled-tag" and added reviewers @Riley @Iris :robot_face:
Kai (Design): thanks — next: Riley implements PR, Iris reviews a11y, Sasha wires telemetry, Noah signs copy. will iterate on figma after PR merges :sparkles:
